WITH film_totals AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) AS total_films FROM film
),
actor_film_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    a.actor_id,
    COUNT(fa.film_id) AS film_count
  FROM actor a
  LEFT JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id
  GROUP BY a.actor_id
),
avg_fraction AS (
  SELECT AVG(film_count) AS avg_count FROM actor_film_counts
),
actor_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    afc.actor_id,
    afc.film_count,
    ft.total_films,
    af.avg_count,
    afc.film_count / ft.total_films AS fraction,
    af.avg_count / ft.total_films AS avg_fraction,
    (afc.film_count / ft.total_films) - (af.avg_count / ft.total_films) AS difference
  FROM actor_film_counts afc
  CROSS JOIN film_totals ft
  CROSS JOIN avg_fraction af
)
SELECT 
  actor_id,
  film_count,
  fraction,
  difference
FROM actor_stats
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: All actors in the actor table are included, even those with zero films credited
